purpose: Distinguish runner and external-script variation without replacing the failed postdeployment audit.
runnerSelection: Accept both ordinary allocated runners without benchmark-based selection or exclusion.
retryPolicy: No automatic or manual retry, extra capture, early success stop, or replacement of failed results.
setupFailurePolicy: Keep the predetermined allocation and failed setup state. Unstarted captures are not successful measurements.
contaminatedRuntimePolicy: If browser cleanup, collector restoration, or executable integrity fails, retain remaining planned entries as blocked and unstarted. Do not measure in a known contaminated environment. Ordinary measurement failures continue after successful cleanup and restoration.

control.validation: Exact trace UserTiming markers, fixed checksums, completion and observed wall duration; no adaptive work or minimum TBT requirement.

observer.collection: Read the actual measured response with CDP at loadingFinished before Lighthouse closes its page; hold only in memory, hash decoded bytes after CLI completion, discard body.
observer.missingOrAmbiguousResponse: Retain invalid or unavailable evidence; never refetch or substitute a separate request.
observer.overhead: Observation adds work. Apply it consistently; do not equate these instrumented timings with an uninstrumented rerun.

artifactPolicy: Publish only allowlisted metrics, safe source labels, trace task summaries, body hashes, guard receipts, source hashes and all attempt outcomes. Never publish cookies, headers, response bodies, raw devtools/trace/report/HTML or arbitrary environment values.
interpretation: Report each runner's three-sample result and every attempt. Two runners are two host allocations, not six independent hosts. Correlation or a later passing sample does not prove causation, erase the original failure, authorize budget correction, or authorize a production behavior change.
